products.title: 5-amino-1MQ

products.description: 5-amino-1MQ (5-amino-1-methylquinolinium) is a small-molecule quinolinium salt, not a peptide. pricing.stackingRule: A unit receives one discount only. When a unit qualifies for more than one of the bundle, reorder and quantity discounts, the largest percentage applies (on a tie: bundle, then reorder, then quantity). Set allowStacking to true to apply bundle and reorder in sequence; the quantity discount never stacks, and it applies instead when it gives the lower price.

quantity.rule: Buying more units of the same option (same product, dose and pack) lowers the unit price of every unit of that option in the bag. The tier is chosen by the total units of that option in the bag: the highest tier whose minUnits is reached applies. Units of other options do not count toward the tier. Checkout calculates the tier price on the server.

singleVialCurve.rule: A single vial (an option sold as 1 vial) uses this curve instead of the quantity tiers. The percent off every vial of that option in the bag rises with the number of vials: 1 vial 0%, 2 vials 2%, up to 9 vials at 11%, so 9 vials cost about the same as the kit of 10. At convertToKitAt vials (10) the line becomes one kit of 10 at the kit price; the kit's quantity tiers then apply to the kits. Vials left over after each full kit stay single vials priced by the curve. The bag, the shop tile, the product page and checkout run the same conversion, so the shown price is the charged price. Becoming a kit needs kit stock. One discount per unit; the larger one applies.

reorder.rule: A returning customer who opens a paid order (receipt link) can reorder. Units of any variant that appears in that paid order get percentOff off the unit price at checkout. The original order must be paid and no older than maxAgeDays. Other items in the bag pay the listed price.

bundles.rule: A bundle is a set of separately listed single-compound kits. Its price is the sum of the component list prices with percentOff off each unit. The bundle price applies only while the bag holds every component in the bundle quantity. A bundle is hidden when any component is not sellable.
